title: Seokju Kang
text:
Seokju Kang





I am currently a Ph.D. candidate in Management Engineering at UNIST, advised by Prof. Hyun Jin Jang. Prior to that, I received my B.S. in Industrial Engineering from Pusan National University in February 2024.


My research domain is in Financial Engineering, with a particular emphasis on risk management, derivatives pricing, and quantitative finance. I am also working on AI/OR applications in finance.


E-mail: jukang@unist.ac.kr
